summary: GitVerse published the Android v1.0.4 release with three signed ABI-specific APKs. No APK binaries were added to Git.

checks.name: Tag-triggered Android release
checks.observation: The public GitVerse release page lists BOOHTACORD-android-v1.0.4-arm64-v8a.apk (36.6 MiB), BOOHTACORD-android-v1.0.4-armeabi-v7a.apk (28.1 MiB), and BOOHTACORD-android-v1.0.4-x86_64.apk (42 MiB).

checks.name: Git release asset size limit
checks.observation: All three APK assets are below the workflow's 95,000,000-byte pre-upload limit and are downloadable from GitVerse Releases.

checks.name: APK binaries excluded from repository history
checks.observation: The release consists of GitVerse release assets; the release source revision contains only the app version bump and no APK files.

remaining: Install the appropriate ABI APK on a physical Android device and complete device acceptance; this evidence verifies publication, not runtime behavior.
